verdict.rationale: Forter is a SaaS fraud-decisioning platform. Whether it can be self-hosted is a fair deployment question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Forter-operated services: API calls to Forter, Forter-hosted fields, Forter-provided test and production environments, and a 'Forter handles everything' integration. Nothing documents a self-hostable core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
